definition: Relevant, pertinent, and directly applicable to the specific reviewer inquiry or research focus.
etymology: From Middle English germain ('having the same parents').
manuscriptExample: Only literature germane to mammalian homolog regulation was cited in the introduction.
conferenceExample: The referee's comment was highly germane, leading us to incorporate an essential negative control.

definition: The sequential selection of specific cell populations based on fluorescence or scatter parameters in flow cytometry.
manuscriptExample: Detailed flow cytometry gating strategies are provided in Supplementary Figure S3.
conferenceExample: Reviewer 1 requested singlet gating controls to rule out doublet contamination in the live-cell gate.
